rationale: Public SOP requires Website/Lab needed-or-not-needed decisions. Drift review shows Website/Lab vendored manifests are stale if Protocol manifest changes. Keeping Protocol projection and downstream pointer sync as separate immediate follow-up goals preserves repo boundaries and avoids blocking Protocol planning on sibling repo mutation authorization.
option_a: Protocol only and leave Website/Lab for later: safe only if release window explicitly excludes downstream pointer freshness.
option_b: Protocol projection, then separate immediate Website/Lab pointer-sync goals if manifest changes: selected default plan.
option_c: Block Protocol projection until Website/Lab same-window sync planned: use only if owner declares Website/Lab pointer freshness part of the same public release completion criteria.

website.sync_needed_decision: owner_decision_required_for_release_window; current vendored manifest is stale if public manifest is updated

validation_lab.sync_needed_decision: owner_decision_required_for_release_window; current vendored manifest is stale if public manifest is updated
